name: How can I get more closet storage without making my bedroom feel smaller?

mainEntity.name: How can I get more closet storage without making my bedroom feel smaller?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A bedroom closet should be planned around what you actually store, how you access it, and how much wall and floor area can be dedicated to storage. Measure hanging garments, folded items, shoes, luggage, and seasonal belongings before selecting shelves or drawers.

A larger closet is not automatically better if it reduces comfortable circulation or blocks windows. Door type, lighting, ventilation, drawer clearance, and access to an adjoining bathroom can change the layout.

Key factors:
- Long-hang, double-hang, shelving, and drawer needs.
- Reachable heights and clear floor space.
- Sliding versus hinged doors.
- Dedicated outlets or lighting for dressing areas.

Bring a rough inventory to the design meeting and identify items that must stay accessible. Elite Remodeling & Design can incorporate storage into the measured plan instead of treating the closet as an afterthought.
acceptedAnswer.description: Inventory what you store, then design hanging space, shelves, drawers, lighting, and door clearances around those items. A larger closet can hurt circulation if it blocks windows or consumes too much floor area. Plan storage with the full room layout.
